description: Returns the app's site: the Development address (the private preview every publish lands on) and the Live address (public, once a version is put live), the version each serves, whether the Live site is offline, every version (when, by whom, how many files and bytes, its status), how long the Development site has been idle, and each of the app's own domains for the Live site — its status (connecting, live, needs attention) and the one record to add. env live reads from the Live side. Changes nothing. This is what a founder may call their website and its address.
name: site_status
title: The site
